df['ldh_missing'] = df['lactate_dehydrogenase_result'].isna()
print("\nLDH missingness associations:")
# Gender
df_g = df[['ldh_missing','gender']].dropna(); ct = pd.crosstab(df_g['ldh_missing'], df_g['gender'])
chi2, p= chi2_contingency(ct)[:2]; print(f" Gender: p={p:.3f}")
# Ulceration
df_u = df[['ldh_missing','ulceration_indicator']].fillna('Unknown'); ct = pd.crosstab(df_u['ldh_missing'], df_u['ulceration_indicator'])
chi2, p= chi2_contingency(ct)[:2]; print(f" Ulceration: p={p:.3f}")
# Clark level
df_c = df[['ldh_missing','clark_level']].fillna('Unknown'); ct = pd.crosstab(df_c['ldh_missing'], df_c['clark_level'])
chi2, p= chi2_contingency(ct)[:2]; print(f" Clark level: p={p:.3f}")
# Age at diagnosis
ages_nm = df.loc[~df['ldh_missing'],'age_at_diagnosis'].dropna()
ages_m = df.loc[df['ldh_missing'],'age_at_diagnosis'].dropna()
stat, p = kruskal(ages_nm, ages_m); print(f" Age: Kruskal p={p:.3f}")

df[event_cols] = df[event_cols].fillna('NO')
df['any_new_tumor_event'] = np.where(df[event_cols].eq('YES').any(axis=1),'YES','NO')
print("\nComposite event counts:")
print(df['any_new_tumor_event'].value_counts())

# 3. LDH status with missing-as-category
df['ldh_status'] = df['lactate_dehydrogenase_result'].fillna('Unknown')
print("\nLDH status counts:")
print(df['ldh_status'].value_counts())

ct_all = pd.crosstab(df['ldh_status'], df['any_new_tumor_event'])
ct_e = ct_all.reindex(index=['Normal','Elevated'], columns=['NO','YES'], fill_value=0)
print("\nContingency (Normal vs Elevated):")
print(ct_e)
if ct_e.shape==(2,2): stat, p = fisher_exact(ct_e.values); print(f"Fisher p={p:.4f}")
print("\nFull contingency including Unknown:")
print(ct_all)

# Prepare model variables

df['ulcer_f'] = df['ulceration_indicator'].fillna('Unknown')

})

print("\nFull model summary:")
